back: Countries reducing barriers to trade and factor movement between them and coordinating economic policies.

front: List the forms of economic integration in order.
back: Preferential trade area → free trade area → customs union → common market → economic (monetary) union.

front: Free trade area versus customs union?
back: Both remove tariffs between members; a customs union also has a common external tariff.

front: What does a common market add to a customs union?
back: Free movement of labour and capital between members.

front: African Union: when launched and headquarters?
back: 2002 (replacing the OAU, 1963); Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. AfCFTA agreement signed 2018, trading from 2021.

front: Give three benefits of integration for Zimbabwe.
back: Wider markets and economies of scale; cheaper imports; investment and shared infrastructure; bargaining power.

front: Give three problems of integration for Zimbabwe.
back: Competition from stronger members; lost tariff revenue; overlapping memberships; poor infrastructure and slow borders.
